entries.title: Numbers 32:1
segments: ¶And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had much cattle, a very great multitude; and they saw the land of Jaazer, and the land of Gilead, and behold, the place was a place for cattle.

entries.title: Numbers 32:2
segments: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the assembly, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 32:3
segments: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jaazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

entries.title: Numbers 32:4
segments: the country that Jehovah smote before the assembly of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle;

entries.title: Numbers 32:5
segments: and they said, If we have found favour in thine eyes, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession: bring us not over the Jordan.

entries.title: Numbers 32:6
segments: And Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall *ye* abide here?

entries.title: Numbers 32:7
segments: And why do ye discourage the children of Israel from going over into the land that Jehovah has given them?

entries.title: Numbers 32:8
segments: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land:

entries.title: Numbers 32:9
segments: they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, and discouraged the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land that Jehovah had given them.

entries.title: Numbers 32:10
segments: And Jehovah's anger was kindled the same time, and he swore, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 32:11
segments: If the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob! for they have not wholly followed me;

entries.title: Numbers 32:12
segments: save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; for they have wholly followed Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 32:13
segments: And Jehovah's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation was consumed that had done evil in the eyes of Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 32:14
segments: And behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, a progeny of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Jehovah toward Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 32:15
segments: If ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

entries.title: Numbers 32:16
segments: ¶And they drew near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones;

entries.title: Numbers 32:17
segments: but we ourselves will go with diligence armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place; and our little ones shall dwell in the strong cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

entries.title: Numbers 32:18
segments: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited each one his inheritance.

entries.title: Numbers 32:19
segments: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side the Jordan, and further, because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side the Jordan eastward.

entries.title: Numbers 32:20
segments: And Moses said to them, If ye do this thing, if ye arm yourselves before Jehovah for war,

entries.title: Numbers 32:21
segments: and all of you that are armed go over the Jordan before Jehovah, until he have dispossessed his enemies from before him,

entries.title: Numbers 32:22
segments: and the land is subdued before Jehovah, and afterwards ye return, ye shall be guiltless toward Jehovah and toward Israel, and this land shall be your possession before Jehovah.

entries.title: Numbers 32:23
segments: But if ye do not do so, behold, ye have sinned against Jehovah, and be sure your sin will find you out.

entries.title: Numbers 32:24
segments: Build yourselves cities for your little ones, and folds for your flocks, and do that which has gone out of your mouth.

entries.title: Numbers 32:25
segments: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commands.

entries.title: Numbers 32:26
segments: Our little ones, our wives, our cattle, and all our beasts shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

entries.title: Numbers 32:27
segments: but thy servants will pass over, every one armed for war, before Jehovah to battle, as my lord says.

entries.title: Numbers 32:28
segments: ¶So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 32:29
segments: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben pass with you over the Jordan, every one armed for battle, before Jehovah, and the land be subdued before you, then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

entries.title: Numbers 32:30
segments: but if they do not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Numbers 32:31
segments: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Jehovah has said to thy servants, so will we do.

entries.title: Numbers 32:32
segments: We will pass over armed before Jehovah into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance on this side the Jordan shall be ours.

entries.title: Numbers 32:33
segments: And Moses gave to them, to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og the king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and territories, the cities of the land round about.

entries.title: Numbers 32:34
segments: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

entries.title: Numbers 32:35
segments: and Atroth-Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbebah,

entries.title: Numbers 32:36
segments: and Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-haran, strong cities, and sheepfolds.

entries.title: Numbers 32:37
segments: --And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elaleh, and Kirjathaim,

entries.title: Numbers 32:38
segments: and Nebo, and Baal-meon (of which the names were changed), and Sibmah; and they gave other names to the cities that they built.

entries.title: Numbers 32:39
segments: --And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and they dispossessed the Amorites that were therein.

entries.title: Numbers 32:40
segments: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

entries.title: Numbers 32:41
segments: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took their hamlets, and called them Havoth-Jair.

entries.title: Numbers 32:42
segments: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and its dependent villages, and called it Nobah, after his name.
